races.verdict: This is wide open and it could pay to side with NELSON MUNTZ who returns from a break off a handy-looking mark and is taken to gain an overdue success at the chief expense of Downpatrick runner-up Dairy Force . Vaureal can also play a prominent role back in this sphere after a chasing victory at Punchestown. Max Meridius completes the shortlist back over a shorter trip. NELSON MUNTZ (IRE) DAIRY FORCE (IRE) VAUREAL (FR)

races.verdict: BLACK HEATHER hasn't been seen over hurdles for nearly 15 months but has been in solid form on the Flat this summer and is greatly favoured on these terms so gets the nod. C&D winner Rocky's Howya rates a major threat as he bids to extend his unbeaten sequence in claimers to 5, while Rich Belief and Allo Al Khawaneej also enter the reckoning. BLACK HEATHER (IRE) ROCKY'S HOWYA (IRE) RICH BELIEF

races.verdict: GONE IN SIXTY isn't an obvious follow-up candidate given his record but with Sean Bowen retaining the ride, he's worth chancing to defy a 5 lb higher mark for his Stratford success. Soldier In Mayo shaped well on last month's return/chasing debut behind a well-handicapped rival at Bangor and rates next best with improvement likely. Sedgefield scorer Socks Off rounds off the shortlist. GONE IN SIXTY SOLDIER IN MAYO (IRE) SOCKS OFF (IRE)

races.verdict: Ralph Beckett has a fine record in this so his Frankel newcomer YAMANA , who fetched 1,500,000 guineas as a yearling, is taken to make a winning start at the chief expense of Somerton , who rates the clear pick of those with experience. races.verdict: ACT OF VIOLENCE has held his form well since winning at Ripon in July and, with pace down the centre of the track, he could get a good tow into this race and come out on top again. Trafalger is well treated if confirming his recent return to form and looks a danger, while Spirit of Applause makes obvious appeal down in 0-70 company if stall 1 doesn't prove a hindrance.
